tools.name: get_hotel_info
tools.description: Neozoom location, room types, supported guests, booking workflow and official links. Represents this hotel only.

tools.name: search_rooms
tools.description: Live Neozoom room tariffs for two adults; optional bathtub/terrace/kitchen and total-stay budget filters.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Fresh selected-room tariff, a 5-minute signed quote, and explicit cancellation/tax limitations. No hold.

tools.name: create_booking_link
tools.description: Recheck selected quote and return an attributed Neozoom hosted checkout URL. Creates no booking, cart or payment.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Create a REAL Neozoom reservation after guest confirmation/consents. Requires hotel-issued Authorization bearer. Same key on retries; never auto-retry unknown outcome.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Read only this credential's booking and reconcile with the hotel's stored Bnovo result. No payment claim.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_booking" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
